result:
The transformation pickers no longer cut off at 50 or 100 (D-181): every acceptance check exits 0, and the two chromium-ar tests that used to fail now pass with their spec files unchanged.

**What I did.** I reviewed the partial work from the interrupted run and found the source complete and correct, so I changed no code. The new shared hook in `apps/web/src/api/queries.ts:245/:276` loads every page of the existing transformation list. It uses the API's own page limit, so the contract is unchanged. If any page fails, the whole list shows a translated error with "Try again" (en and ar) rather than a partial list. Thirteen screens use it: all 12 named in the assignment plus `MyProceduresPage`. The only other screen that loads one page at a time is the transformation list itself, which has proper paging and isn't a picker. No screen was kept as a "recent" shortlist.

**Before the fix.** The old e2e failure log came from the interrupted run, so I recorded it again against the committed spec. I temporarily restored the old `MyProceduresPage.tsx`, rebuilt, ran the new spec and restored the fix. Both chromium-en and chromium-ar failed (exit 1): the newest transformation was not an option (expected 1, received 0). Screenshots are saved. The earlier unit run also showed the 4 picker tests failing before the fix.

**Checks:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| DG4 historical validator, at start and end | PASS, exit 0 |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, prettier check, `pnpm openapi:lint` | all exit 0 |
| `unit-web`, locale unset | 91 files, 1722 tests passed |
| `unit-web`, `C.UTF-8` | 91 files, 1722 tests passed |
| New spec plus the three named specs, `--workers=1`, chromium-en and chromium-ar, one database per run, locale unset | 20 passed, 0 failed, 0 flaky |
| The same, `C.UTF-8` | 20 passed, 0 failed, 0 flaky |

**Run order.** Playwright ignores the command-line file order, so my spec ran last in each browser project, not first as the assignment asks. As a result, the two formerly failing chromium-ar tests (`p5-procedure-outputs.spec.ts:39` and `p5-procedures-automation.spec.ts:256`) ran after the database already held more than 100 transformations. That is the original failure condition, and both passed. The after-fix Arabic screenshot shows the newest transformation (TR-0112) selected.

**Not run.** The full `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:integration` and the full e2e suite were not run, per D-164; they belong to your merged-tree verification.

**Other items:**
- **Contract, schema or dependency needs:** none.
- **ADRs:** no statement is made untrue. ADR-0007 could optionally get a note that pickers load every page (for T-DG5-ARCH-R7).
- **User-facing text:** the "Choose a transformation" texts were untrue before, because the lists were cut silently. They are true now in en and ar, with no wording changed.

Nothing in my scope remains. My evidence and the handback are uncommitted on top of the work-in-progress commit `69ac4f0`; `CLAUDE.local.md` is untracked and not mine.
